title: Operations on Tree
goal: Apply lock, unlock, and upgrade operations on a rooted tree.
strategy: Locks store their owner. Upgrade requires an unlocked node, no locked ancestor, and at least one locked descendant; only after all checks pass does it clear descendant locks and lock the node.

edgeCases: Upgrade fails when no descendant is locked
A locked ancestor blocks upgrade but not ordinary lock
Only the owner may unlock an already locked node
